name: wikipedia
description: Wikipedia (any language, no API key): search, page summaries, plain-text content, media lists, nearby pages and language links (WebAssembly build)

nodes.title: Search Wikipedia
nodes.description: Full-text search: title, pageid, snippet (HTML with <span class=searchmatch>), wordcount and timestamp of matching articles

query.description: Search text; supports intitle:, incategory:, quotes

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

language.description: Wikipedia language code, e.g. en, id, de, ja, simple (default: WIKIPEDIA_LANGUAGE or en)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Page summary
nodes.description: Short summary of a page: title, description, extract (plain text lead), thumbnail, coordinates and URLs

page_title.description: Page title, e.g. "Borobudur" (spaces are fine; redirects are followed)

language.description: Wikipedia language code, e.g. en, id, de, ja, simple (default: WIKIPEDIA_LANGUAGE or en)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Page content (plain text)
nodes.description: The article as plain text (section headings as lines), capped at max_chars: {pageid, title, extract, truncated, total_chars}

page_title.description: Page title, e.g. "Borobudur" (spaces are fine; redirects are followed)

intro_only.description: Only the lead section before the first heading

language.description: Wikipedia language code, e.g. en, id, de, ja, simple (default: WIKIPEDIA_LANGUAGE or en)

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters of text (default 20000)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Page media list
nodes.description: Images, audio and video used on a page: title (File:...), type, caption and srcset thumbnail URLs

page_title.description: Page title, e.g. "Borobudur" (spaces are fine; redirects are followed)

language.description: Wikipedia language code, e.g. en, id, de, ja, simple (default: WIKIPEDIA_LANGUAGE or en)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Pages near a place
nodes.description: Articles with coordinates near a point, nearest first: title, pageid, lat, lon, dist (meters)

coordinates.description: Latitude and longitude separated by "|", e.g. "-7.6079|110.2038"

language.description: Wikipedia language code, e.g. en, id, de, ja, simple (default: WIKIPEDIA_LANGUAGE or en)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Page in other languages
nodes.description: The same article in other Wikipedias: langlinks [{lang, title, url}]; next_cursor when there are more than limit

page_title.description: Page title, e.g. "Borobudur" (spaces are fine; redirects are followed)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

language.description: Wikipedia language code, e.g. en, id, de, ja, simple (default: WIKIPEDIA_LANGUAGE or en)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Wikipedia (MediaWiki Action and REST v1 APIs) request
nodes.description: Call any Wikipedia (MediaWiki Action and REST v1 APIs) endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/w/api.php?action=query&list=random&rnnamespace=0&format=json". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/w/api.php?action=query&list=random&rnnamespace=0&format=json"

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
